decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall be strictly limited to the scope of works as set out in the Bartlett Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) ref. GD.250708.AMS and shall adhere to this AMS at all stages.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

An auditable schedule of arboricultural supervision and inspection of tree protection measures by a suitably qualified arboriculturist shall be provided. This will include supervision of all stages of the proposed works. Upon the completion of each supervision visit, the findings and agreed actions / timescales arising from them shall be reported to the LPA by the arboriculturist by way of summary report supplemented with photographs where appropriate. The condition shall not be discharged until it has been demonstrated that compliance with the agreed AMS has been satisfactorily achieved.Reason: Required to satisfy the Local Planning Authority that the tree will not be damaged during the works hereby approved and to ensure compliance with the agreed Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS).
